specification.execution_instructions:
Conduct this single bounded joint design-and-control study through real public tools. First evidence_read the original frozen task via rl.frozen_task and each scoped_context reference. Read the specification and all remaining budgets. One joint length-and-motion solve is required: research_plan action mechanics, supported task_gap or task_gap_with_effort, design_bounds [-1,1], original duration/control grid, supported variables and existing initialization. Explain task relevance, assumptions, objective weights and relaxations. The outer solve allowance is3300s, research_work_v1 removes internal CPU/wall limit, max_iterations1000. Read the result and checkpoint_reference (progress) explicitly. No second solve on failure. A timeout is no feasibility verdict; cite last recorded stage. If a candidate exists use existing handoff/propose mechanics_source; a fallback reference d0 has reference provenance, distinct from joint-optimized d0. At most one supported independent integration/replay300s if needed.
Choose an actually admitted NMPC or RL route using actual evidence and budget. Do not force both routes. NMPC requires matching existing timing; no calibration or admission bypass. Fixed-design RL may choose supported direct/residual, PPO and reward weights; residual requires an advertised compatible validated reference and honest mathematical provenance. Research_rl starts only fixed selected candidate, never length optimization during training. At most2 trials, requested ceilings200000 actions/1200 active seconds per trial,400000 actions/2400 seconds total; action requests round DOWN to whole n_steps rollouts and record requested/effective. Never round up or reset costs.
After each start/resume the framework waits deterministically for terminal/failure by default, with no provider polling. Then research_rl status; evidence_read its terminal training_summary_reference; only if a usable checkpoint exists request one independent saved-policy evaluation identifying actual checkpoint step; evidence_read result; choose next action with evidence. With no usable policy explicitly read failure summary and decide an authorized action or STOP, no nonexistent evaluation or automatic restart. Trials/corrections consume the same cumulative ceilings. Two fresh confirmations are reserved among at most5 evaluations, or among4 NMPC executions capped1800s. One optional physical diagnostic60s/one supported step maximum. Aggregate numerical10800s, live elapsed14400s including900s delivery; no transfer from supplemental. Last16 model requests protect existing status/stop/evaluation/evidence/selection-confirmation/STOP; no start/resume/solve/new exploratory execution. Provider64/public160 are ceilings, not targets.
Freeze original task target[.29,.035,.19], zero initialization,.35s duration,.01s control,.0005s physics,.01m position,.02m/s speed,inclusive samples30-35. Only a complete original-task pass may be selected via confirm selected_execution; freeze exact design/controller/config/task/checkpoint and perform precisely2 fresh independent post-selection confirmations, explicitly read each. Retain failed confirmations; no retries seeking2 successes. Cite every new mechanics/controller result and each terminal training summary in truthful STOP with next_step and concrete recommendation. Scientific failure is acceptable. No credentials/raw environment/unrelated data transmission. Preserve actual model calls, reads, decisions and all costs.
Each research_plan confirm selected_execution call BOTH selects/freezes (first call) and EXECUTES ONE fresh confirmation. For two confirmations call it twice with the SAME passing development selected_execution, then explicitly read each result. NEVER use research_rl evaluate to request confirmations; it is a development evaluation and protects confirmation slots. The supplemental model made this exact wrong-tool error and closed at1/2 despite a second legal confirmation being available; read the factual correction. Use run_id (no runtime_id); status/evaluate/resume/stop supply only operation,run_id,rationale and supported operation-specific fields, not mode,candidate,task or training overrides.
